Capture scope and responsible use

Coverage: all five primary pages, all five Assessment governance tabs, all three Simulator tabs, and all three Reports tabs. Nineteen screenshots include the two-dimensional flow and a presentation-only scenario snapshot. This is a selected-viewport tour, not a screenshot of every row, scroll position, filter, modal, or role-specific editor.

Source: an authorized, authenticated live assessment and current planning inputs were pseudonymized before transfer into a separate browser running the unchanged application. API responses were replayed locally. Workflow changes stayed in that browser; all other API operations and external network requests were blocked.

Redaction: account, organization, team, user, and other private strings were replaced or masked. Numeric text, amounts, input fields, and canvases were covered before PNG files were saved. Chart geometry, categorical states, and visible row presence may still convey qualitative information. This is not a guarantee of complete anonymization; review audience suitability before distribution.

Interpretation: simulator and recommendation views are derived planning output. No provider approvals, executed control changes, savings outcomes, or certifications are asserted. The daily trend shown by the UI must not be treated as independently verified historical evidence in this showcase.

Boundaries: the 3D canvas is not showcased because its numeric labels are not covered by DOM text redaction; the readable 2D mode is included. The live register was empty with reader access, so populated record editors and revision histories are not represented. Saved-report history was not replayed, and no PDF generation or restore action was executed.

Validation: the capture completed without browser application errors. Images are embedded in the Word package, with no live JSON, credentials, or external image links included. The companion HTML provides a visual review of the same content; Word pagination may differ by installed fonts and version. This document is not completion evidence for the earlier governance-reference acceptance audit.
